settings.heading: Limited time offer
settings.text: Exclusive styles at 30% off, only for three days!

The all-new lineup of Srixon ZXi Fairway Woods boasts the tour-caliber ball speed and long-game performance necessary to top the leader board, while their refined shape and new adjustability options guarantee they'll be the talk of the clubhouse.

settings.title: i-FLEX FACE
settings.text: This completely redesigned face thickness pattern produces more efficient energy transfer at impact, increasing ball speed.

settings.title: REBOUND FRAME
settings.text: Rebound Frame is an entirely unique system that amplifies energy transfer at impact. By utilizing two flex zones, instead of one, Rebound Frame maximizes flex across the face to increase power, ball speed, and, ultimately, shot distance.

settings.title: ADJUSTABLE HOSEL
settings.text: An all-new, 1.5-degree hosel sleeve lets you fine-tune every ZXi Fairway Wood's loft, lie, and face angle.

settings.title: CARBON CROWN & CROWN STEP
settings.text: The 3-Wood and 3+-Wood use a strong but lightweight carbon crown, positioning mass low and maximizing COR. Their stepped crown design lowers the clubheads' Centers of Gravity, ultimately raising launch trajectory for higher, longer shots. However, the 5-Wood and 7-Wood do not include a stepped crown, prioritizing improved spin and accuracy numbers rather than distance.

settings.title: REFINED TOUR SHAPING
settings.text: Progressive new footprints for ZXi Fairway Woods feature a flatter leading edge and more grounded toe, along with an improved sole shape for increased forgiveness.
